subject.title: feat(config): add compaction.thinkingLevel to override thinking level during compaction

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support `agents.defaults.compaction.thinkingLevel` as an embedded-only configuration option while native Codex app-server compaction warns and ignores it?
rationale: The patch is mechanically bounded, but it adds a durable public configuration and plugin-SDK surface with intentionally different behavior across embedded and native Codex runtimes; that contract cannot be selected safely by automated review.

options.title: Approve the embedded-only contract
options.body: Accept the optional setting, its per-candidate clamping, and the documented native-Codex warning as supported behavior.

options.title: Keep the current single-level behavior
options.body: Decline the new public option and retain session-level inheritance for all compaction paths until a cross-runtime design is desired.

recommendation.title: Approve the embedded-only contract
recommendation.body: Accept the optional setting, its per-candidate clamping, and the documented native-Codex warning as supported behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Their integration and follow-up commits connect them directly to the proposed config and SDK contract.
